voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: This plane has never been found. In July nineteen thirty-seven, Amelia Earhart flew it out over the Pacific, and vanished.
Weeks earlier, on the world flight. Her navigator, Fred Noonan, climbs aboard.
The longest leg: New Guinea to Howland Island, a speck of coral in the open Pacific.
A Coast Guard ship waited offshore. Its log records her voice: we must be on you, but cannot see you.
She never landed. Some think the fuel ran out. Others look here, to Nikumaroro, where a twenty twenty-six search found nothing conclusive.
